mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a temperature of 46 degrees and a third quarter moon visible near the Verona Public Library.

This October, the city is celebrating Community Planning Month to recognize the contributions of our Planning and Development Department, plus residents can now sign up for free rides on the new tri-shaw bikes at the Senior Center.
You can catch yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by plenty of trivia options across town including Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee happening tomorrow.
Looking at the recent police report, on September 19, a 10-year-old child was safely reunited with their parents after a brief search near Lincoln Street.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist, and the store will be opening its doors today at 10:00 AM.
